model_detail: No LLM used for core decision logic. Business rules are deterministic Python. Each agent implements a specific domain responsibility per EC_POLICY_V1.

agents.name: OrderSellerAgent
agents.role: Retrieves order status, items, seller info, shipping dates

agents.name: PaymentAgent
agents.role: Reconciles payment rows against item+freight totals

agents.name: DeliveryAgent
agents.role: Compares actual delivery vs estimated date and seller handoff vs limit

agents.name: PolicyAgent
agents.role: Applies EC_POLICY_V1 rules in priority order, computes refund and action

agents.name: VerifierAgent
agents.role: Validates evidence IDs, amounts, schema before writing output JSON

data_source: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist (Kaggle)
